name: Follow-ups
description: Makes sure every lead hears from you within two days.

brings: A table of every lead and when they were followed up
Drafts for quiet leads, every weekday
The week's number in Pages, every Friday

how: Every lead is a row in leads, with when it came in and whose it is
A lead quiet for 36 hours gets a drafted follow-up for its owner to approve
never: Send a follow-up its owner has not approved

outcome.sentence: Every lead gets a follow-up within two days.
outcome.measure: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE followed_up_in_time) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) FROM leads WHERE came_in_at >= date_trunc('week', now())
